_what: Worked input for scripts/gen-pack.mjs. The checks list is optional: it asserts that the domain needs these atoms and lets the generator confirm the default composition covers them. It cannot add or remove a rule. Copy this file, replace the domain facts, and run the generator into an empty directory.
title: Tidal weir siltation study
description: Claims about whether silt deposition at a tidal weir can be established from surface imagery alone.

quantities.name: silt.deposition_mm
quantities.measures: mean silt depth on the upstream sill, in millimetres

quantities.name: flow.residual_cm_s
quantities.measures: residual current at the weir crest, in centimetres per second

quantities.name: silt.visual_fraction
quantities.measures: operator-estimated silt fraction from a surface photograph

liveVars.name: gate_opening_m
liveVars.why: both arms must hold the gate at the same opening or discharge differs

liveVars.name: instrument_depth_m
liveVars.why: the turbidity probe must sit at the same depth in both arms

liveVars.name: tide_stage_m
liveVars.why: tide stage moves during a field run and cannot be held constant
